items.html: At the time when the coupling Malchut ascended from the place of the mouth to the openings of the eyes, the coupling was made there, and the light came out through the openings of the eyes and not through the mouth. (Item 6).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 118:1
items.html: From the Chazeh downward of Yetzirah and Assiyah descended, because of the sin, to the place of the fourteen lower Sefirot, and clothed themselves in the dwelling place of the Klipot. And on Shabbat they have an ascent to Atzilut. Therefore the taking out of the feet outside the Shabbat boundary — which is the aforementioned Chazeh [chest] — is forbidden, so as not to bring them down again to the place of the Klipot, as they were during the week. (Items 96 and 97).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 119:1
items.html: The place of Yetzirah was made from the discernment of the ZA of the body, which was darkened and went out below the conclusion of Atzilut, at the time of the ascent of the concluding Malchut to the Chazeh [chest] of the Partzuf Nekudot of SAG, which is called the externality from the side of the back. See above, answer 97. Therefore Yetzirah is considered the back of the ZA of Atzilut. And at the time of the first correction of BYA, when they were corrected from the discernment of the front of the backs of the seven dead kings, the world of Yetzirah was already in the place of the ZA of Atzilut, being its back. And after the sin it descended with a great descent, because the four lower [Sefirot] of Yetzirah clothed themselves within the dwelling place of the Klipot. And the Mochin that it receives come out upon a screen of phase one, which is the screen of ZA from the discernment of VAK without a head. And the five Partzufim of the world of Yetzirah are in the level of the middle thirds and the lower thirds of the NHY of AA, which are also the discernment of the externality from the side of the back, like the place of Yetzirah, because the upper thirds of the NHY of AA, which are the discernment of the externality from the side of the front, were clothed only in the world of Beriah, and they are the discernment of the GAR of the NHY that are lacking in Yetzirah. And these two lower parts of the NHY of AA clothe in the VAK of the VAK of the upper AVI, and they are the VAK of YESHSUT, and they are the VAK of ZON. (Item 5, Item 83, Item 93, and Items 224 to 228).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 120:1
items.html: Before the sin, at the beginning of the emergence of BYA from the breaking, the place of the ten Sefirot of Yetzirah was in the four lower [Sefirot] of the ZA of Atzilut and the six upper [Sefirot] of Beriah. And the place of the ten Sefirot of Assiyah was in the four lower [Sefirot] of Beriah and the six upper [Sefirot] of Yetzirah. And after the sin, the ten Sefirot of Yetzirah fell to the place of Assiyah that was before the sin, because the six upper [Sefirot] of Yetzirah fell to the place of the six lower [Sefirot] of Assiyah before the sin, and the four lower [Sefirot] of Yetzirah fell lower, because they fell to the dwelling place of the Klipot. (Item 48).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 121:1
items.html: The Land of Israel is the aspect of Yetzirah of this world. (Items 44 and 49).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 122:1
items.html: In the second aspect of the world of Assiyah, the four lower [Sefirot] of Assiyah were in the place of the Nukva of ZA of Atzilut, and all of Yetzirah was in the place of ZA of Atzilut; then Yetzirah and Assiyah were back to back, like ZON back to back, for Assiyah clothed only from the Chazeh [chest] of Yetzirah and downward, back to back. (Item 87).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 123:1
items.html: In the third aspect of the world of Assiyah, when even the six lower ones of Assiyah ascended to the place of the Nukva of Atzilut, then Assiyah turned her face opposite the face of Yetzirah, face to face, like ZON face to face. (Item 87).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 124:1
items.html: The three worlds BYA were clarified from the vessels and sparks that are from the Chazeh [chest] of the seven kings of Nekudim that were broken, and downward. And the ZON of Atzilut were clarified from the vessels that are from the Chazeh of the seven kings and upward, as is known. Therefore the completion of their clarification is that they will return and join with the ZON of Atzilut, which are the vessels from their Chazeh and upward. Therefore Yetzirah, which is the posterior of ZA, must ascend to the place of the ZA of Atzilut of smallness, which clothes from the Tabur of AA and downward. For then ZA must clothe AA, and from the Chazeh of ZA and downward will be the aspect of from the Chazeh of AA and downward, and then Beriah ascends to the two lower thirds of the Tifferet, from the Chazeh to the end of the Tifferet; and Yetzirah ascends to its NHY, and Assiyah to the place of the female. It is found that the YESHSUT and ZON of the present, in the weekday, which stand in the place of the posterior vessels of AA, are the place of the three worlds BYA. And this is the secret that ZA must be AA, and BYA as the posterior of AA, which is the place of the YESHSUT and ZON of the present. (Items 81 and 82).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 125:1
items.html: At the time of the second restriction, when the concluding Malchut ascended to the place of the Bina of the body of the Partzuf TNHY of AA, which is the Chazeh [chest], then the posterior vessels of this Partzuf descended to the empty void, for the vessels from the Chazeh and downward, which are called the posterior vessels, are already found below the concluding Malchut. (Item 3).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 126:1
items.html: The vessels from the Chazeh [chest] and downward, which descended below the conclusion of the second restriction, as above in answer 125, are also called external vessels, and they have two aspects: one, the externality from the side of the front, which are the two lower thirds of the Tifferet; and two, the externality from the side of the back, which are the NHYM. And both descended to the empty void at the time of the second restriction. (Item 3).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 127:1
items.html: In the second aspect of the world of Assiyah, before the sin, when BYA ascended to Atzilut, except for the six lower ones of Assiyah, the holiness concluded at the Chazeh [chest] of Beriah, for these six upper ones of Beriah were in the secret of the expansion of the city, which is still considered as the city, that is, Atzilut. Therefore only twenty-four Sefirot remained as an empty void: the four lower [Sefirot] of Beriah and the twenty of Yetzirah and Assiyah. See above, answer 23. (Item 85).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 128:1
items.html: There are three garments on the body, which are IBM, and in the Nukva they are three times ten Sefirot, which are thirty Sefirot. But in ZA, who has only nine Sefirot and lacks Malchut, for the Nukva in her entirety is his Malchut, the three garments of his body are found to be only twenty-seven Sefirot. (Item 165).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 129:1
items.html: The GAR of Beriah, which are from the Mochin of SAG of Ima, are not actual GAR, but only the aspect of the power of the GAR of Ima. For the screen in the Parsa, upon which these Mochin came out, already cut off from them the illumination of Atzilut, which is the essence of the GAR of Ima, and therefore only the power of the GAR of Ima remained in them. (Item 201).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 130:1
items.html: The Chazeh [chest] of every Partzuf and downward is discerned as the aspect of the posterior vessels of that Partzuf, which are the two lower thirds of the Tifferet and the NHYM. And the two lower thirds of the Tifferet are discerned as the front within the posterior. And the essence of the posterior is the NHYM. See above, answer 97. (Items 143 and 145).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 131:1
items.html: The posterior vessels from the Chazeh [chest] of every Partzuf and downward are sometimes called the external vessels of the Partzuf. (Item 1).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 132:1
items.html: The vessels from the Chazeh [chest] and upward, that is, HBD HGT up to the Chazeh, are always called the inner vessels. And the reason is that the Chazeh is the aspect of the point of the conclusion of the second restriction, and therefore there is a Parsa in the middle of its body, like the Parsa beneath Atzilut, which separates between the vessels above the Chazeh, which are the aspect of Atzilut and the aspect of the inner vessels of that Partzuf, and the vessels from the Chazeh and downward, which are the aspect of BYA and the aspect of the posterior vessels of that Partzuf. Therefore all the grip of the Klipot is only in the posterior vessels, but in the inner vessels of the Partzuf they have no grip whatsoever, for even the judgments of the second restriction never struck them. (Item 143).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 133:1
items.html: The ten Sefirot are divided into internal vessels and external vessels. For there are only three internal vessels in the Partzuf, KHB, or the brain, the bones, and the sinews. But the ZON separated from the vessels of the Partzuf in the secret of a garment and a palace. Therefore the two vessels, the flesh and the skin, which are the aspect of ZON, are only incomplete external vessels, and they do not join with the internal vessels, but only surround the internal vessels all around. (Item 107),

items.html: The Malchut of Ima never enters in the aspect of the Mochin of ZA, and the aspect of the smallness of the bottom Hey in the Einayim is fixed in her always, and through this she guards her children ZON from the externals, in the secret of the wings that separate between ZON and the externals, which hover over the skin of ZON from outside, and the externals have nothing to suck, for through the wings only a very small light comes out of ZON and outward, that is, what is separated from the illumination of Hochma by reason of the covering of the wings, which are the aspect of the light of smallness, as above. Also, the aspect of the Parsa beneath Atzilut is made from this aforementioned Malchut of Ima, and therefore the Parsa is called by the name the shoe of ZON, for it guards the feet of ZON from the externals, by the power of the covering of the Parsa, so that only a small light passes through it, in which there is nothing of the illumination of Hochma. (Item 32).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 136:1
items.html: When there are judgments in ZON, that is, whenever they lack GAR, the Klipot can grip in their posterior, that is, in the vessels from the Chazeh [chest] and downward. And to be guarded from them, the correction of back to back is made, so that their backs are inward and their faces are exposed outward, and from the faces they cannot suck. And this correction of the concealment of the posterior is called a covering. Therefore the world of Yetzirah, which is VAK without a head, needs the aspect of this covering. Therefore Assiyah was made in the aspect of three within three, in order to become the aspect of a covering over Yetzirah, so that the externals cannot suck from them. Therefore there are two aspects in the world of Yetzirah: food and covering. Food: they are the Mochin to sustain it. And the covering is the aspect of the covering of the world of Assiyah, which covers it from the externals. But in Assiyah there is only food alone, for it does not need to cover another, since in its very essence it is the covering, as above. (Item 135).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 137:1
items.html: The ten Sefirot of the Mochin of Ima expand in the world of Beriah: the GAR are called the Throne, the VAK are called the six steps to the Throne, and the Malchut clothes in the Malchut of Beriah and is called the Throne of Judgment, Techelet, Sandalfon. For the first nine of the Mochin are the aspect of the Throne of Mercy, and the Malchut is the Throne of Judgment. The explanation: the Mochin of Ima that shine in Beriah come out upon a screen of phase two in the mouth of the Yesod of Ima, which is included in the Parsa beneath the feet of the Nukva of ZA, this being because of the clothing of Ima in the Nukva, and the feet of Ima are found touching the Parsa, which is the power of the conclusion of Atzilut and the aspect of judgment. Therefore the GAR of Ima, which clothe in the internality of the KHB of Beriah, are called by the name the Throne of Honor, indicating the power of the Parsa included in the screen, through whose reflected light all these Mochin of GAR came out. Therefore, although it is a Throne, from the word covering over the light of Atzilut, which is the secret of the Honor, nevertheless it is a Throne of Mercy, for all the Mochin came from the clothing in this reflected light. However, at the end of the Mochin, at their conclusion, the power of the conclusion itself is found revealed, which concludes upon the Mochin, that is, the concluding Malchut. And there all the power of judgment included in the Parsa is revealed, and therefore the Malchut of Ima, which clothes there at its conclusion, is called by the name the Throne of Judgment, for the judgments in it stand there. And likewise Techelet, from the word and the people held back from bringing etc., for the power of the GAR of Ima, which is the secret of the mercy, could not pass through it and downward. And for this reason it is also called Sandalfon, like the sandal that guards the feet from the externals. And it has now been explained that the Mochin of Ima in Beriah in their entirety are called the Throne of Honor, for Atzilut is the secret of the Honor, and since the Mochin came out upon a screen included in the Parsa that concludes Atzilut, they are also found to be the aspect of a covering over the Honor. However, the first nine of the Mochin are discerned as the Throne of Mercy, since the power of the GAR of Ima is in them. But the Malchut of the Mochin, which is the aspect of the concluding Parsa itself, is called the Throne of Judgment, Techelet, Sandalfon. (Items 151 and 152).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 140:1
items.html: Before the sin, the First Man had NRN from the BYA of Atzilut. And after the sin, the nine upper [Sefirot] of the lights of each and every Sefira of his NRN of Atzilut departed from him, together with the nine lower [Sefirot] of the vessels of each Sefira of the NRN, and there remained in him only the lights of the Nefashot of each Sefira and the vessels of the crowns of each Sefira. And even these were not from the aspect of Atzilut, but from BYA, below the Parsa, for the BYA were blemished because of his sin and descended below the Parsa of Atzilut. And the matter of the remaining of the crowns of the vessels and the lights of the Nefashot is by reason of the inverse value between the vessels and the lights: for as long as there is in him only the vessel of the crown, only the smallest light, which is the light of the Nefesh, can clothe in it, as is known. (Item 125).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 142:1
items.html: Before the correction of the three worlds BYA, the entire place of BYA was an empty void, because the concluding Malchut beneath the feet of AK ascended to the place of the Chazeh [chest] of the Partzuf TNHYM of AK. And likewise, after the three worlds BYA were corrected, and after they ascended in the third aspect of the world of Assiyah, before the sin, to the YESHSUT and ZON of Atzilut, thirty Sefirot of the place of BYA again remained in the aspects of an empty void, for the BYA had already departed from them. (Item 93).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 143:1
items.html: There are three garments on the body of the Nukva, which are the IBM of her posterior, and in each garment there are ten Sefirot, and they are called the thirty degrees of the Nukva. (Item 166).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 144:1
items.html: The three garments of the Nukva are IBM, and the garment of the nursing is her middle garment, the garment of the pregnancy is the outer garment, and the garment of the Mochin is her inner garment. (Item 165).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 146:1
items.html: When Ima clothes in ZON, in order to give Mochin to Beriah, the Nukva of ZA is considered the outer garment of Ima, through whom she bestows the Mochin to Beriah. For the world of Beriah cannot receive except from the Nukva of ZA, for she is its upper one. (Item 35).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 150:1
items.html: This world is divided into BYA and the place of the Klipot, for the place of the Temple is its Beriah, the Land of Israel is its Yetzirah, and outside the Land is its Assiyah. And the desert is the place of the Klipot. (Item 44).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 151:1
items.html: At first, the entire place of BYA was the place of the Klipot. And after the vessels of the ZAT of Nekudim broke, front and back, and fell to BYA, the front and the back were mixed one within the other, and through this the place of BYA also expanded to the aspect of the inner vessels, and thirty Sefirot were made in them, HBD HGT up to the Chazeh [chest] for the inner vessels, and TNHY from the Chazeh and downward for the posterior vessels. However, they were included one within the other before the clarification. And afterwards, in the world of correction, the inner vessels of the ZAT of Nekudim, whose breaking was not because of themselves but because of their being joined with the posterior vessels, were clarified, and they became the ZON of Atzilut. And afterwards the aspect of the posterior of the ZAT was clarified from the Klipot, which are the three worlds BYA. However, not all the posterior, but only the aspect of the front of the posterior, which are the 288 that were included and mixed in the posterior; but the aspect of the Malchuts in them, which are the thirty-two Malchuts called the thirty-two stones, could not be clarified any more, and they remained the aspect of Klipot, in which there is no benefit at all. Therefore, after them, the place of BYA was also divided, for the three worlds BYA, which were clarified from the inner vessels of the posterior, took their place from the Chazeh of the place of BYA and upward. And the Klipot, which are the aspect of the posterior of the posterior, took their place from the Chazeh of the place of BYA and downward, which is related to them. And they are the fourteen Sefirot that became a permanent dwelling place for the Klipot, that is, only during the course of six thousand years, at a time when there is no clarification or correction for the thirty-two stones. However, at the completion of the correction, when the coupling of the bottom Hey, which is hidden in RDL"A, is revealed, in the secret of the stone the builders rejected has become the head of the corner, then will be fulfilled, and I will remove the heart of stone etc.

items.html: The Malchut of Bina, who is not included in the Mochin of ZA and always remains in the light of smallness, surrounds ZON from outside them and protects them in the secret of a partition, so that the externals cannot grip in ZON. And this is the secret of the garments and shoes of ZON, for the guard beneath their feet, in the secret of the Parsa beneath Atzilut, is the secret of a shoe. And that which surrounds them in their entire stature is the secret of the garments. (Item 33).

items.html: Malchut has no light of her own, that is, by way of the coupling in her own Partzuf, for the screen has already been refined, and only a root of coarseness remains in it, and therefore it is not sufficient for the aspect of a coupling of striking. And everything she has, she must receive from the coupling made in ZA, her husband. (Item 41).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 159:1
items.html: The Malchut of the head, in which the screen was corrected for a coupling of striking with the upper light, is called the coupling Malchut. And she raises the reflected light according to the measure of the coarseness in the corrected screen in her, and clothes the ten Sefirot of direct light from below upward. And afterwards she expands from within her with her reflected light from above downward, and brings out the ten Sefirot of the body, until she reaches her concluding Malchut, in which the degree is cut off. (Part 1, Page 888, Sub Header, "and he raised").

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 161:1
items.html: And one must understand well the matter of the three worlds BYA, for on the one hand we say that they are the posterior of YESHSUT and ZON, that Beriah is of the coarseness of phase two, Yetzirah is of the coarseness of phase three, and Assiyah is of the coarseness of phase four. And on the other hand we say that the world of Beriah came out on a screen of phase two, Yetzirah on a screen of phase one, and Assiyah on a screen of the aspect of a root. Which, at first glance, contradict one another.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 162:1
items.html: Because the screen of phase two is included together with the Parsa that concludes Atzilut, the screen becomes the aspect of a literal screen, separating all the illumination of Hochma from the Hassadim. See above, answer 52. (Item 31).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 165:1
items.html: If the screen does not hold back the light of the GAR, it is called a near screen, since it has some closeness to Hochma, and this closeness is called GAR, which is not the essence but the power of the GAR in Ima. But the screen of Yetzirah, which holds back the light of the GAR completely, is called a distant screen. (Items 36 and 37).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 167:1
items.html: In a place where there is the rooting of the second restriction, there is the reality of a coupling to correct the broken vessels and bring them out of the Klipot. And this begins in YESHSUT, from the Chazeh [chest] of AVI and downward, in the secret of the Vav of the filling of the HaVaYaH of SAG. See above, answer 36. (Item 18).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 168:1
items.html: At the time of the second restriction, when the concluding Malchut ascended to the Bina of the body of the Partzuf of the TNHY of AK and of the Partzuf of the points of SAG, and the two lower thirds of the Tifferet and the NHYM went out below the concluding Malchut into the empty void, they then became the aspect of the place of BYA. For the two lower thirds of the Tifferet became the place of Beriah, and the NHY the place of Yetzirah, and the Malchut the place of Assiyah. (Item 8).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 170:1
items.html: Just as the place of BYA in its entirety is divided into the three worlds BYA, which are the place of holiness, and into the fourteen Sefirot, which are a permanent dwelling place for the Klipot, so this world is divided into the place of settlement, which includes BYA, the place of the Temple, the Land of Israel, and outside the Land, and into the place of ruins, which are the deserts, where there is no settlement of people, a land that no man has passed through. (Item 44).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 172:1
items.html: The four Sefirot in the posterior of ZA are the place of the Nukva, that is, from the Chazeh [chest] and downward. And the reason for the matter, see above, answer 56. (Item 56).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 173:1
items.html: The point of the conclusion of the direct lights, that is, the line of the Ein Sof, is also the point of the conclusion of the circles and of the direct [lights] of the surroundings, both in the first restriction and in the second restriction. Only the difference is that in the direct lights the point of the conclusion is found below, and there it holds back the light from expanding further. But in the surrounding lights the point of the conclusion is found in their center, in such a way that the innermost circle of the surroundings, which is their last, surrounds the point that concludes the direct [lights]; and the place of the point is the aspect of an empty void, both of the inner lights and of the surrounding lights. (Item 4).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 175:1
items.html: It is the nature of every screen to hold back the upper light from passing from its Tabur and downward, and therefore when the upper light meets it, a coupling of striking is made, for it pushes the light backward and raises the reflected light and clothes the direct light, as is known. And sometimes the upper light overcomes the screen and breaks the power of its holding back, and passes through it from there and downward, and this is called breaking and cleaving. And this is at the time of the diminution of the moon, for the nine lower [Sefirot] of the Partzuf of the posterior of the Nukva cleaved the screen and the Parsa beneath Atzilut, and passed through them downward to BYA. (Item 233).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 177:1
items.html: From the aspect of the Mochin fixed in Atzilut, AA stands in the place of ZA, and AVI in the place of the Nukva: for AA clothes the HGT of Atik, which are found in the place of the HGT of Nekudim, which are ZA; and AVI clothe from the Peh of AA and downward, which is from the Chazeh [chest] of Nekudim and downward, where is the aspect of the place of the Nukva of ZA. And when the clarifications of ZA are completed, he will then return to the GAR of AA, which is his true place. And likewise, when the clarifications of the Nukva are finished, she will return to the GAR of AVI, where her true place is, as above. And even before the completion of the corrections, on Shabbatot, ZA ascends to the place of AA and the Nukva to AVI. However, besides this not being permanent, the BYA also remains an empty and void place, empty of all light. And at the completion of the correction this will be permanent, and the feet of Atzilut will expand to BYA. (Item 82).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 178:1
items.html: Even in the aspects of the breaking that have no clarification yet, before the completion of the corrections, which are the Klipot called the thirty-two stones, there are still remains of holy sparks in them, which are the secret of the eleven spices of the incense, and they are indeed very small sparks. (Item 11).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 179:1
items.html: The upper one clarifies from the Klipot only the lower one that is near to his degree. For example, AVI clarify only for ZA, whose sparks are near to AVI, and likewise in all the degrees. And the reason is that the entire matter of the ascent and the correction, by which the lower one is corrected by means of the upper one, is because the AHP of the upper one are always attached to the GE of the lower one, and therefore they are corrected with him, as is known. And this is possible only in the degree adjacent to him, in which his AHP are placed. But not so in the degree below his lower one, with which he has no connection whatsoever. (Item 22).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 180:1
items.html: The screen of ZA locks Beriah, for it is a screen of phase one, and what passes through it is the aspect of VAK without a head. And it is found to lock the light of Beriah, which is the aspect of GAR, so that nothing passes from it and downward. And likewise it guards it from the externals. Therefore it is called by the name a shoe. (Item 39).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 181:1
items.html: The shoe of Yetzirah, which guards its lights from passing through it and downward, and likewise from the nursing of the externals, is made from the screen of Malchut in the aspect of the coarseness of a root, for what passes through it is only the aspect of NHY, lacking HGT, that is, a Nefesh lacking Ruach. See above, answer 161. (ibid.).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 182:1
items.html: There are two aspects of Nefesh and Ruach in the ten Sefirot: the first are the Nefesh and Ruach that clothe in the internal vessels, the brain, the bones, and the sinews. And the second are the Nefesh and Ruach that clothe in the external vessels of the skin and the flesh. And the reason is that there are only three vessels in the Partzuf, KHB, which are called the brain, the bones, and the sinews, in which NRN clothe. But for Haya and Yechida there are no vessels, and they only clothe within the light of the Neshama, in the vessel of the brain. And although there are two more vessels, the flesh and the skin, the lights of Ruach and Nefesh cannot descend from the bones and the sinews to them to clothe there, in order to give room for the lights of Haya and Yechida to clothe in the vessels of the brain and the bones, because these vessels of the flesh and the skin are not complete internal vessels, but only the aspect of external vessels, which are not fit to clothe the internal Nefesh and Ruach. Therefore Haya and Yechida are compelled to clothe within the light of the Neshama. And nevertheless, the vessels of the skin and the flesh receive the aspect of the illumination of Nefesh and Ruach from the Nefesh and Ruach in the internal vessels, and they are called the external Nefesh and Ruach. (Part 1, Page 986, Sub Header, "and from here").

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 183:1
items.html: There are only three vessels in the Partzuf, KHB, in which NRN clothe, and they are called the internal NRN. And there is the aspect of Ruach and Nefesh that clothe in the vessels of ZON, which are the flesh and the skin, called the external vessels, and they are called the external Nefesh and Ruach. See above, answer 182. (Part 1, Page 986, Sub Header, "from here").

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 184:1
items.html: Before the sin, the First Man had NRN of Atzilut, and after the sin all the limbs of his soul fell away from him, and there remained in him only the light of the Nefesh in the vessels of the crowns. See above, answer 43. (Item 119).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 185:1
items.html: It has already been explained that there are internal NRN and external Nefesh and Ruach. And these, of the internal NRN, are considered the aspect of the Neshama of BYA, and from them are born the NRN of the righteous, which are the aspect of Divinity. And of the external Nefesh and Ruach it is said, "from there it was parted", for everything born of them is the aspect of the externality of BYA, which are separated and are not Divinity, that is, the angels, the firmaments, and the palaces, etc.

And they are the secret of the seventy cubits and the remainder, which are still considered as the city itself, for likewise these seven Sefirot of Beriah are considered like the body of Atzilut, although they are already below the Parsa of Atzilut. And the reason, see above, answer 34. (Item 84, and in the Inner Light, Sub Header, "and they protrude").

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 197:1
items.html: Behold, in general there are two pregnancies: the first pregnancy is made by the upper one, at the time when the lower one is still in the Klipa and has no reality whatsoever in holiness, and then it is corrected together with the AHP of the upper one, that is, at the time when the upper one raises and corrects his AHP, the GE of the lower one are drawn after them and are corrected with them, because they are always attached one to the other, as is known. And this was on the eve of Shabbat, in the first aspect, because the First Man was created, for then the worlds ascended by themselves, since each and every one was clarified by its upper one, and the lower one itself could not help itself, for it had no reality at all yet. Therefore they are then discerned as ascending by themselves, that is, not by their own [doing].

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 198:1
items.html: In the world of Beriah there are three aspects: food, covering, and conjugal rights. But in Yetzirah there is no aspect of conjugal rights, for conjugal rights means a coupling to beget offspring, and therefore in Beriah, where there are the Mochin of the GAR of Ima, there is a coupling to beget souls for the angels of Yetzirah. But in Yetzirah itself, where there are no GAR, there is no conjugal rights, but only food and covering alone, that is, only a coupling to sustain the worlds, and not to beget souls. And this is called food. And this coupling, to sustain the worlds, is also practiced in the world of Assiyah. Only the aspect of the covering, which is the aspect of a cover before the externals, is not practiced there toward itself, for it itself, in its entirety, is the aspect of a covering over the world of Yetzirah. (Items 132 to 138).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 200:1
items.html: Every lower one is born and comes out in the mouth of the head of its upper one, and descends from there and clothes the upper one from outside. And it is discerned that the essence of the light of the lower one remains in the upper one, and only the aspect of a branch of it reaches the lower one. (Item 6).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 201:1
items.html: On Shabbat, when the worlds ascend to Atzilut, the world of Atzilut is discerned by the name "city", for there is all the settlement, and about it it is said, "let no man go out of his place on the Shabbat day". And up to the Chazeh [chest] of Beriah is the secret of the seventy cubits and the remainder, which are added to the city in the secret of the expansion of the city. And from there to the Chazeh of Yetzirah is the secret of the two thousand cubits of the Shabbat boundary. And from the Chazeh of Yetzirah and downward is a permanent dwelling place for the Klipot, and there it is outside the Shabbat boundary, from which it is forbidden to go out, as it is said, "let no man go out of his place on the Shabbat day". (Item 84).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 204:1
items.html: In practice, the matter of the second restriction was made only in the Partzuf of the points of SAG of AK, which is clothed within the Partzuf of the TNHY of AK, from its Tabur and downward. And in it the concluding Malchut of this world ascended to the point of its Chazeh [chest], and it brought out the vessels from the Chazeh and downward to the aspect of an empty void, and they became the place for BYA. And likewise, all the matters that were renewed with the second restriction begin only from the Tabur of AK and downward. For every diminution begins to rule only from the place of its emergence and downward, and nothing [rules] above the place of its emergence.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 205:1
items.html: The emergence from the Einayim means the coupling made there in the openings of the eyes, which brought out the ten Sefirot of Nekudim in their measure. And the matter of the ascent of the light was before this, meaning that the concluding Malchut ascended to the place of the Bina of the body, and the light departed from the vessels from the Chazeh [chest] and downward; and likewise the ascent of the coupling Malchut to the openings of the eyes, which brought out the ZON outside the head. And at this time the fall of the vessels from the Chazeh and downward of the points of SAG was made, to the aspect of the empty void beneath the feet of AK. And afterwards the coupling was made in the openings of the eyes, and the circles and the direct [lights] of the smallness of the Nekudim came out, and they returned the vessels from the Chazeh and downward to their former place, but in the aspect of an empty void, empty of all light, because of the power of the conclusion in the Parsa, which holds back the upper light from passing to them, as is known. (Items 2 and 3).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 206:1
items.html: The ascent of the Musaf [additional prayer] of Shabbat is like the first aspect of the First Man, which he had at the time of his birth. (Item 99).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 207:1
items.html: The ascent of the Mincha of Shabbat is like the second aspect, before the sin, when ZA is in the place of AA and the Nukva in the place of AVI, and BYA in the place of YESHSUT and ZON of Atzilut, except for the six lower ones of Assiyah, which are in the six first ones of Beriah. (Item 100).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 208:1
items.html: The Tree of Knowledge is in Assiyah, that is, the aspect of the Chazeh [chest] and downward, which is called Assiyah. And the essence of the Chazeh and downward is the middle line, which is Yesod, for Yesod is called a tree. And this is the secret of the wicked tree that cried out, "do not touch me". (Item 48).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 216:1
items.html: The essence of internality and externality: behold, the place of BYA, which was made from the posterior vessels of the Partzuf of the points of SAG, is the externality. And everything within this place, that is, the worlds and what is in them, which were clarified from the posterior of the seven kings that died, is the internality of BYA. However, there are yet several more kinds of internality and externality: one, the inner and outer in the ten Sefirot of the Partzuf of BYA, where the three vessels KHB, in which the internal NRN clothe, are the internality of the ten Sefirot. And two, the vessels of ZON, or the skin and the flesh, in which the external NRN clothe, and likewise the illumination of the surrounding lights of Haya and Yechida, are the externality of the ten Sefirot. Two, they are the offspring born of them: for what is born of the internality of the Sefirot is the souls of human beings, and they are called the internality of the worlds; and what is born of the externality of the Sefirot, which are the souls of the angels, is the externality of the worlds. Also the garments, the palaces, and the firmaments, etc., are born of the externality of the Sefirot, and they are the externality of the worlds. And likewise, in general, the lights and the vessels are discerned as inner and outer: the lights are the internality, and the vessels in which the lights clothe are the externality. And there are yet more discernments of inner and outer. And the matter of the source of the division of the inner and outer, see above, in answer 91. (Item 91.)

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 217:1
items.html: The external vessels in the ten Sefirot, in BYA, which are the two vessels of the flesh and the skin, in which the external Nefesh and Ruach [clothe], also have a relation of surrounding lights to the ten Sefirot. For it is impossible that the two lights of Haya and Yechida will return to the Partzuf, unless these five vessels of ZON return to be internal vessels of the Partzuf, as above in answer 185. And the lights of Haya and Yechida are also the ones that clarify these vessels of ZON, to make them fit to be internal vessels, and therefore the external vessels are discerned as the aspect of surrounding vessels of the ten Sefirot. However, the surrounding lights themselves cannot clothe in them, since they are the aspect of ZON, which separated from the vessels of the body, and the vessels of the surroundings are made only from the ZON that separated from the lights of the head, for the surrounding lights have no grip except in the head and the GAR, as is known. (Item 177).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 225:1
items.html: The second restriction is the secret of the association of the quality of mercy with judgment, for Malchut, which is the quality of judgment, was joined with Bina, which is the quality of mercy, as it is said, "and the two of them went". And this caused the second restriction in the worlds. For at first the world was created with the quality of judgment, because the screen was corrected in the vessel of Malchut, which is the quality of judgment, and the first nine were clean of the restriction. And when Malchut ascended to Bina, the screen was made in the openings of the eyes, and it brought out the AHP from the ten Sefirot of the head, to the aspect of a body. And likewise, the concluding Malchut ascended to the half of the Bina of the body, and brought out the TNHY into the empty void, for the restriction was made in the place of the Parsa of Atzilut. (Item 3, and in the Inner Light, Sub Header, "and he raised").

items.html: The screen of phase two, which serves for the exit of the ten Sefirot in the stature of Ima and is corrected in the Yesod of Ima, is called the feet of Ima. And since Ima clothed in ZON in order to bestow Mochin to Beriah, her aforementioned feet are found touching the Parsa beneath Atzilut, and she was included in it, and because of this the Mochin of Beriah came out in the aspect of Hassadim separated from Hochma. See above, answer 52. (Item 198).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 235:1
items.html: The Mochin of the upper AVI are the secret of the Mem of the Tzelem and the aspect of covered Hassadim, and they are the aspect of surrounding lights for ZON, for they receive only from YESHSUT, which are the Lamed of the Tzelem and the aspect of revealed Hassadim. However, when ZON are in smallness, then Ima, who is YESHSUT, is in the secret of one who crouches over her children, and she bestows to them then only the aspect of the Hassadim of the upper AVI, which are surrounding lights, and not from her own aspect, for they are not yet fit for revealed Hassadim. Therefore it is discerned that Ima crouches over him in the secret of surrounding lights, for these Mochin of AVI are only the aspect of surrounding lights for ZON, and not inner lights. (Item 205, and in the Inner Light there, Sub Header, "spreads").

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 236:1

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 237:1
items.html: The first nine Sefirot of the Nukva are called the head, and her Malchut is called the tail. (Item 239).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 238:1
items.html: The head of AA, which is the stature of AB, is called the head of the thirteen corrections. And it alludes to the AB of the Mazal, that Bina returned to be Hochma by means of the MAN of the Dikna, and bestows Hochma to ZA. (Item 213).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 239:1
items.html: The head of Atik is called the revealed head, or RDL"A, because the lower ones have no attainment whatsoever in it. (Item 222, and Etz Chaim, Gate 47, Chapter 6).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 240:1
items.html: A coupling that sustains the worlds and has no aspect of begetting is called food. (Item 132).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 241:1
items.html: They are the sparks of the heel, which are the holy sparks that remained of the thirty-two sparks and have no clarification before the completion of the correction. They are called Jacob, for they are remnants of the three-within-three of Assiyah — that is, until the completion of the correction there can be clarified, from the aspect of the aforementioned MA of Malchut, only the aspect of the Aviut of the root, which brings out only the stature of Malchut; and from the aspect of the correction of the lines it is called NNH, so the first nine are found missing from her, and they are considered by the name of remnants of the three-within-three. And they will not be clarified completely until the future, when the Malchut of Radla is revealed in the secret of "the stone that the builders rejected has become the head cornerstone." (Item 138).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 244:1
items.html: Assiyah is called the two thousand years of Tohu, for Tohu is the aspect of the Klipot, and in the world of Assiyah are all the Klipot. And the world of Yetzirah is the two thousand years of Torah, for Yetzirah is the aspect of ZA, and ZA is the Written Torah. And the world of Beriah is the two thousand years of the days of the Messiah, for Beriah is the aspect of Ima. And all redemption comes from the side of Ima, which is called freedom and liberation, and it is Leah, the mother of Mashiach ben David. (Items 63 and 111).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 245:1
items.html: Adam HaRishon before the sin included all three worlds BYA, and they are the secret of the six thousand years, in the secret of "six thousand years is the duration of the world," as mentioned above in answer 244. Therefore Adam HaRishon also included, corresponding to them, six thousand degrees of souls. (Item 113).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 246:1

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 248:1
items.html: The participation of the quality of judgment together with the quality of mercy, which was made in the second restriction, is the participation of the Serpent [Shitufa de-Tanina]. And in the future, at the completion of the correction, the second restriction will then be abolished and the world will return to its former state, to the aspect of AK, which is the first restriction. And so in AA, which is the stature of AB, the second restriction is not discernible in him, and there is no participation of the Serpent in him. And this is the secret of what is said of the completion of the correction: "See now that I, even I, am He, and there is no god with Me," and the Zohar interprets it as meaning that there is no participation in Him. For then the world will return to the degree of the first restriction, without the participation of the quality of mercy in judgment. (Item 18).
